<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def Mpos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M': return (round(sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])/len(n['boundary']),1),
                                    round(sum(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])/len(n['boundary']),1))
def Wpos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W' and 8<=n['pixels']<40 and n['boundary'][0][1]>5:
            return (round(sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])/len(n['boundary']),1),
                    round(sum(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])/len(n['boundary']),1))
def Gpos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='G' and 8<=n['pixels']<40:
            return (round(sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])/len(n['boundary']),1),
                    round(sum(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])/len(n['boundary']),1))
m,w,g=Mpos(current_frame),Wpos(current_frame),Gpos(current_frame)
print("M,W,G:",m,w,g,"| anchor=2M-W:",(round(2*m[0]-w[0],1),round(2*m[1]-w[1],1)))
# Test goal: bring Wblob onto the diamond
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':round(g[0]),'col':round(g[1])}], intent='explore')
m2,w2,g2=Mpos(current_frame),Wpos(current_frame),Gpos(current_frame)
print("after click diamond:",m2,w2,g2)
print({k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','level']})

def Mpos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M': return (round(sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])/len(n['boundary']),1),
                                    round(sum(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])/len(n['boundary']),1))
def Wpos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='W' and 8<=n['pixels']<40 and n['boundary'][0][1]>5:
            return (round(sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])/len(n['boundary']),1),
                    round(sum(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])/len(n['boundary']),1))
def Gpos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='G' and 8<=n['pixels']<40:
            return (round(sum(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])/len(n['boundary']),1),
                    round(sum(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])/len(n['boundary']),1))
m,w,g=Mpos(current_frame),Wpos(current_frame),Gpos(current_frame)
print("M,W,G:",m,w,g,"| anchor=2M-W:",(round(2*m[0]-w[0],1),round(2*m[1]-w[1],1)))
# Test goal: bring Wblob onto the diamond
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':round(g[0]),'col':round(g[1])}], intent='explore')
